title: Delete notebook cell
description: Delete a cell from a markdown notebook by node_id. Nothing downstream is touched: the response lists orphaned_dependents — cells that referenced the deleted cell's dataframe and now need rewriting or deleting. The kernel keeps any already-materialized dataframe until it restarts, so a dependent may still run against the deleted cell's last result; rewrite dependents promptly.
